purpose: Owner review of theme-specific Rain marks for the three D29 source-gap cells. This proposal does not amend D29 or authorize runtime changes.

shared_contract.meaning: Supplied visible Rain text and semantics remain authoritative; artwork is decorative and noninteractive.
shared_contract.size: Show the specimen in the existing 36 dp forecast slot and permit proportional use up to 40 dp in the hero slot.
shared_contract.effects_off: Static, opaque, complete artwork with no glow, blur, translucency, or motion.
shared_contract.fallback: Omit the mark and retain visible Rain text if fit or contrast is inadequate.
shared_contract.inference_limits: Do not add severity, amount, time-of-day, or other meteorological detail. No mark is inferred from a backdrop.

proposals.source_basis: D29 WEATHER_ART.md CLOUDY proposal for Atmospheric: pale foreground cloud contour with restrained dark keyline over the atmospheric field; solid high-contrast contour on surfaces. Same-theme language basis only; no direct Rain art is claimed.
proposals.treatment: One soft-edged, outlined cloud with three separated short falling strokes. Use the established pale contour with a restrained dark keyline and a cool condition accent for the drops. No sky, horizon, rain field, or extra wisps.
proposals.contrast_and_effects_off: The preview uses solid opaque strokes with a static dark keyline around both contour and drops. On flat surfaces use the theme foreground contour; over image-like atmosphere retain the keylines. Effects Off removes any optional effect; none is needed by this proposal.
proposals.fallback: Remove a drop if it crowds the 36 dp slot; omit the mark if cloud/drop separation or contrast fails, retaining visible Rain text.

proposals.source_basis: D29 WEATHER_ART.md CLOUDY proposal for Minimal OLED: one simple white cloud outline with open interior, no shaded fill, gradients, or glow. Same-theme language basis only; no direct Rain art is claimed.
proposals.treatment: One spare white cloud contour and three short separated white falling strokes. Use one line weight, no fill, accent color, glow, gradient, or secondary contour.
proposals.contrast_and_effects_off: Use the opaque foreground white on black or near-black. Effects Off is identical to the static specimen.
proposals.fallback: Simplify by removing a falling stroke if needed; omit the mark if contours merge or lose legibility at 36 dp, retaining visible Rain text.

proposals.source_basis: D29 WEATHER_ART.md Terminal CLEAR, PARTLY_CLOUDY, and CLOUDY proposals use literal monospace console tokens and reject ASCII weather art or blinking characters. Same-theme language basis only; no direct Rain token is claimed.
proposals.source_locator: docs/theme-system/design-pack/WEATHER_ART.md, Terminal/CLEAR, Terminal/PARTLY_CLOUDY, and Terminal/CLOUDY cells; theme basis: docs/assets/design-references/production-themes/one-app-many-personalities/extracted/terminal_phone.png
proposals.treatment: A static monospace `RAIN` token, without brackets, box, cursor, or pictographic mark. The token is decorative and does not replace the caller-supplied condition text.
proposals.contrast_and_effects_off: Use the existing terminal foreground role on its opaque dark canvas. Effects Off keeps the same static token.
proposals.fallback: Omit if the token crowds or displaces visible condition text; retain visible Rain text.

open_owner_decision: Review each treatment and exact retained revision; approve, reject, or request revision. No runtime change is authorized by this artifact.
